update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.36 - Character preset data: running-style aptitudes and growth bonuses
Added / Fixed ------------- - Character presets now include per-character running-style aptitudes (Front/Pace/Late/End) and growth-rate bonuses for every character. These were part of the data schema but were missing from the shipped data (running-style on 0 of 60 presets, growth on 1), so the Smart Race Solver's running-style seeding and per-character growth weighting had nothing to work with. Both are now populated, giving more accurate early-run running-style bias and stat weighting. - Added three newly-released characters that were missing from the preset data: Air Shakur, Bamboo Memory, and Copano Rickey (a strong Dirt runner).
Changed ------- - The character-preset data updater now sources aptitudes over HTTP instead of a browser scrape, so it is faster and far less fragile. This is a developer/data-tooling change with no in-app effect beyond the refreshed data above.
